intro: This page covers ATL’s official Domestic Hourly, Daily, Economy, Park-Ride, ATL West Deck, ATL Select, International Hourly, and International Park Ride lots, with daily rates copied from the official Hartsfield-Jackson parking pages on November 18, 2026. Below that are eight off-airport shuttle lots from four operators whose addresses, shuttle rules, and terminal coverage come from each operator’s own site; we chose operators that publish a street address and shuttle details. Many off-airport lots serve the Domestic Terminal only, so check terminal coverage before you book an international trip. Rates here are dated snapshots, not live quotes.

officialLots.name: Domestic Hourly parking (North and South)
officialLots.area: Closest lots to the North and South Domestic Terminal entrances

hours.notes: The official ATL parking page says the Airport offers 24/7 parking at the Domestic and International terminals.

officialLots.driveUpDailyMax: $50 maximum for the first day; $75 maximum each additional day
officialLots.rateNotes: Official rates as listed on 2026-11-18. The official page describes hourly parking as ideal for picking up or dropping off. The official page lists the lost-ticket fee as the maximum daily rate plus duration of stay.
officialLots.visitNotes: Hourly lots are not listed among the reservable lots on the official page.

sources.label: Official ATL parking details page (rates effective May 1, 2025)

officialLots.visitNotes: First come, first served, according to the official page.

officialLots.name: ATL West Parking Deck
officialLots.area: ATL West, near the Rental Car Center
officialLots.access: SkyTrain from level 4 of the deck; the official page says it is a 3–5 minute SkyTrain ride to check-in and arrivals

hours.notes: The official page does not publish separate hours for this deck.

officialLots.rateNotes: Official rates as listed on 2026-11-18. Ticketless: the system reads your license plate on entry and exit. The official page lists the lost-ticket fee as the maximum daily rate plus duration of stay.
officialLots.visitNotes: Online reservations are available for this deck through the official ParkATL site, for stays over 24 hours and booked at least 24 hours ahead.

listings.name: The Parking Spot 1 (Camp Creek Parkway)
listings.area: Camp Creek Parkway at Potomac Drive, off I-85 exit 72; 2.4 miles to the airport per the operator

hours.notes: The operator's Atlanta page does not publish daily lot hours.

listings.shuttle: Shuttle picks you up at your vehicle. Serves both the Domestic and International terminals. The operator says domestic shuttles run every few minutes and international shuttles run every 30 minutes from the International Covered area.
listings.visitNotes: The only one of the operator's four Atlanta lots with International Terminal service. Park in the International Covered area for that shuttle.
listings.feeNotes: The operator's page says prices depend on your dates and the reservation tool; no dated rate was copied.

listings.name: Peachy Airport Parking — Outdoor lot (Sylvan Road)
listings.area: Sylvan Road, north of the airport

hours.notes: The operator's outdoor-lot page says the free shuttle runs 24 hours a day, but it does not state lot hours for the outdoor lot itself.

listings.shuttle: Free shuttle to the Domestic Terminal only, 24 hours a day, according to the operator. The operator says it does not run shuttles from the outdoor lot to the International Terminal. Domestic pickup is Row D, Space 4 in the off-airport shuttle area outside Door W-1 (North) or W-2 (South).
listings.visitNotes: The operator lists 1,500 outdoor spaces and a gated, well-lit lot. Book the covered or indoor lot for international departures.
listings.feeNotes: The operator says outdoor rates vary by length of stay and season; no dated rate was copied.

listings.name: Peachy Airport Parking — Covered and Indoor (Sylvan Road)
listings.area: Sylvan Road, across the street from the Peachy outdoor lot entrance

hours.notes: The operator says its covered and indoor facilities are open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

listings.shuttle: Free, climate-controlled shuttle 24 hours a day to the Domestic and International terminals, according to the operator. Domestic and international covered lots each have their own shuttle, so book the lot for your departure terminal.
offers: EV charging (Level 1 indoor with your own cord; Level 2 in Building A of Covered)
listings.visitNotes: Entry uses license-plate recognition and QR codes, according to the operator. The operator says free Level 1 charging during an indoor reservation is a rewards-member benefit.

listings.name: PreFlight Airport Parking ATL
listings.address: 4000 Global Gateway Connector, College Park, GA 30337

hours.notes: The operator's ATL page does not publish lot hours. It says airport pickups between midnight and 7:00 AM require a call or text.

listings.shuttle: Free shuttle every 7–10 minutes with real-time tracking, picking up and dropping off at your vehicle, according to the operator. Domestic pickup is space D3 at the Ground Transportation Center; between midnight and 7:00 AM call (404) 767-8000 or text (312) 533-8796. International service requires a Covered (International Only) reservation and parking in rows R, S, V, or W; that shuttle runs on the hour and 30 minutes after the hour.
offers: EV charging (120V outlet, bring your own charger, based on availability)
listings.visitNotes: Call 24 hours ahead for a wheelchair-accessible shuttle, according to the operator.

sources.label: PreFlight Airport Parking ATL location page

listings.name: Park'N Ticket
listings.area: Conley Street, College Park; 1.2 miles to the Domestic Terminal per the operator

hours.notes: The operator's FAQ says it is open 24/7 all year and always has a person on site.

listings.shuttle: Shuttles run continuously 24 hours a day, according to the operator. International Terminal service is limited to 6:00 AM–9:00 PM daily; outside those hours, take the ATL airport bus to the Domestic Terminal. Domestic return pickup is South Ground Transportation slot D2; international pickup is lower-level Door A2 (call after clearing customs).
listings.visitNotes: Independently owned and not affiliated with the airport, according to the operator. Drive-up is accepted; reservations require a 2-day minimum.
listings.feeNotes: The operator says charges run on a 24-hour clock, hourly up to the fourth hour and a full day rate after that. Oversized vehicles are $20 per day, as listed on 2026-11-18 (call first to confirm space).
